title: wheat straw plates
text:
wheat straw plates. UPDATED REVIEW BELOW.....I ordered 3 sets of these (only 2 had arrived as I post this review) for a small family bridal shower - they are pretty cool- nice pastel colors - a little edge to keep food on the plate. We are using them for "high tea" treats so they are the perfect size. Nice and small, ok for the dishwasher and microwave - so they are better than the plastic version. They report no dangerous chemicals. I am happy with the purchase so far, however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: Sadly, even though they SAY they are dishwasher safe, they are not! I washed top rack, plenty of space between, regular wash (short dry). They ALL WARPED. Now, they will not sit flat on a table and therefore garbage. I will be seeking a refund and cannot recommend them. So disappointed. - Further it has been a struggle to get my refund. I was asked to remove my review first. Uh, no.
